name: acceleration_momentum_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, large directional institutional orders (FII flow, ETF rebalancing, index arb) are executed incrementally via TWAP/VWAP algos, causing the 1-minute ROC to ramp up progressively before the full move is obvious. When the 30-second change in 1-minute momentum (ROC_accel) turns positive for 15+ consecutive seconds and its own slope is rising, NIFTY is in the 'jerk phase' — the third derivative is positive, meaning algorithmic participation is actively growing. At 5-second resolution we can enter during this early acceleration window, capturing the first 6-12 option points before reactive momentum traders pile in and the acceleration peaks.
core_signal_oneliner: Positive and rising rate-of-change acceleration (third derivative of price) confirming institutional TWAP momentum buildup in the early phase of a directional move
